name: Silver
note: Peru and Bolivia are top-5 producers.
uses: Electronics and photovoltaic cells, jewellery and silverware, coins and investment, photography.
why_it_matters: Peru and Bolivia are top-five producers; silver travels with the copper, lead and zinc ores of the Andes, so its flows follow the same buyers.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
